1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device __comprises a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium, and wherein said alignment device performs a functional transformation of the demonstrated user actions into aligned document actions that causes a functional change in the operation of the apparatus__.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __and provides feedback that modifies the operation of a user interface__.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface display that changes the appearance of the current step relative to other steps__.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, __wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification that changes the appearance of the current step relative to other steps in the documented procedure__.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment __and provides feedback that modifies the operation of a user interface__.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface display that changes the appearance of the next step relative to other steps__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, __wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification that changes the appearance of the next step relative to other steps in the documented procedure__.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, __wherein said alignment device compares the common strings to determine a degree of correspondence between the demonstrated user actions and the document actions__.

10. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, __wherein the alignment device processes the captured images to extract action information that is compared with the document actions__.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the alignment device stores and retrieves historical data regarding prior alignments and uses such data to improve the accuracy of the current alignment computation__.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, __wherein the document action extractor parses the documented procedure and identifies discrete steps that are stored in a structured format for use by the alignment device__.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein said alignment device comprises a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium and performs a functional transformation of the demonstrated user actions into aligned document actions that causes a functional change in the operation of the apparatus__; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, __wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface display that changes the appearance of the highlighted step relative to other steps__; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, __wherein the scrolling device modifies the display position of the documented procedure on the user interface__.

15. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, __wherein the alignment device processes the captured images to extract action information that is compared with the document actions__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the alignment device stores and retrieves historical data regarding prior alignments and uses such data to improve the accuracy of the current alignment computation__.

(Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the computing step is performed by a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium, and wherein the computing step performs a functional transformation of the demonstrated user actions into aligned document actions__.
